Odisha forest land diversion approved for coal mine

A panel has cleared the diversion of 750 hectares of forest land in Odisha's Angul district for a coal mine project. The decision has been reported by multiple news outlets, highlighting the scale of the land involved. This approval allows for the potential expansion of coal mining activities in the region.
